name: danove-pravo-hmotne
description: Czech substantive tax law practice skill - personal and corporate income tax, VAT including deduction, reverse charge and chain fraud, real-estate transfer and property tax, tax residence and double-tax treaties, transfer pricing, abuse of law and substance, tax aspects of transactions and restructurings, employee vs. contractor, cryptoassets and digital economy, on top of the CODEXIS legal database.
